about.label: About
about.heading: Student first. Builder always.
about.p1: I'm Lukas — a computer science student based in Ulm. I completed my <highlight>dual-study bachelor's degree</highlight> at HTWK Leipzig (2022–2026), where I got to combine university coursework with real-world software development. Now I'm in my masters, digging deeper.
about.p2: I'm drawn to <highlight>web development</highlight>, <highlight>tooling</highlight>, and the kind of projects that are just slightly too ambitious for the time I have — which is usually what makes them worth doing.
about.p3: My GitHub isn't impressive yet. That's fine. I'm still early, and I'd rather be honest about that than pretend otherwise.

contactDesc: I'm looking for <highlight>working student positions</highlight> or <highlight>internships</highlight> where I can contribute meaningfully and keep learning. If you're building something interesting and don't mind someone who asks a lot of questions — let's talk.
